en.html:
...That 'god' was fixing on me before warping space. Stay in its sight and the danger stayed with me.

Toh, make it lose sight of me!
It had no proper intelligence. Finding me again should take time. Surely THAT much could be expected...!

en.html:
Good.
I had slipped behind a suitable rock.

Sound also, I kept down. No point being thorough in only one department.

...Now I should have disappeared from the god's awareness.

We were not far from it here. Wait for an opening, leap out, unleash the electromagnetic draw—

Finished. Bas!

ja.html:
良し。
　うまく、適当な岩陰へ潜り込めだ。

　念のため、音も殺す。

　……これで〝神〟の認識から俺は<ruby>消失<rt>ロスト</rt></ruby>しただろう。

　距離上、ここは敵からそう遠くない。
　隙を見て飛び出し、電磁抜刀を撃ち――

　それで、終わりだ！
